summary_en: Asahi Kasei Homes announced a tender offer for Mori-Gumi at 564 yen per share, targeting acquisition of at least 11,922,100 shares to achieve complete subsidiary status and delist the company. The board endorsed the offer and recommended shareholder participation.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Opinion Supporting and Recommendation to Participate in Public Tender Offer for Shares of Mori-Gumi by Asahi Kasei Homes Co., Ltd., an Affiliated Company
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, the board of directors of Mori-Gumi Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard, Code 1853) expressed support for and recommended shareholder participation in a public tender offer launched by Asahi Kasei Homes Co., Ltd., an affiliated company in which Mori-Gumi is accounted for as an associated company under the equity method.

The tender offer is for the acquisition of Mori-Gumi shares at 564 yen per share, with a minimum purchase target of 11,922,100 shares. This minimum represents approximately 36.4% of outstanding shares (calculated as 11,922,100 divided by 32,749,697 shares, the total issued shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The offer period runs from November 13, 2026 to January 7, 2027, comprising 35 business days. Asahi Kasei Homes currently holds 30.26% of Mori-Gumi shares. The acquisition is intended to achieve complete subsidiary status and delisting of Mori-Gumi, which will be followed by a two-stage acquisition process resulting in non-public status. The board endorsed the tender offer and recommended shareholders to participate, based on detailed evaluation of fairness, business rationale, and procedural safeguards described in the disclosure.
